title: Extract a rescheduled meeting from an email
levels: Every field matches the source and the schema exactly
At least one field is missing, extra, of the wrong type or different from the source

cases.rationale: start_time is "02:30", but 2:30 pm in 24-hour form is "14:30".
Every field matches the email, with 2:30 pm and 4 pm converted to 14:30 and 16:00; the \u0142 escape is the same character as the source's ł.
It gives the rescheduled Thursday date, both times in 24-hour form and the three attendees in order; only the key order differs.
It adds a duration_minutes field that the schema does not list, where the object must hold exactly the eight specified fields.
